_header: UNAUDITED W21-M2-SING: the exact Groebner blocker
note: All runs: Singular 4.4.1 (44105, 64 bit), degrevlex (dp), LIB elim.lib, iterated single-variable sat, macOS arm64.

blocked.system: fixed-y slice y=0101: 30 quartic permanents (ALL 30 L-free words, one fixed R-word)
single all-dirty word x=(1,0,0,2): 81 quartic permanents
theorem chart config (2,2,2,2) all charts rows{0,1}: 16 quartics

tractable.system: theorem chart orbits with >=1 dim-3 site (42 orbits)
FACT A rank>=2 (4x3 with a dead cell), 20 sites

root_cause: The gauge-fixed CELL systems are massively positive-dimensional before saturation (every partial all-zero degeneration is a component), so std must build the whole Groebner basis of a big positive-dimensional ideal before sat can act. Reformulating on the four column-span subspaces V_j = colspan(M_j^x) and working in Grassmannian charts quotients out exactly the torus and GL_d directions that create those components, and the same question becomes a sub-second computation.
